content: N151: Hormuz crisis oil-SPY dynamics. Pre-crisis SPY-USO corr=0.098 (nearly uncorrelated). During crisis: corr increased to 0.188 but still low. Oil (+46.5%) and equity (+13.6%) moved somewhat independently. VIX avg rose from 16.8 to 19.3. Oil shocks transmit to equity via inflation/recession expectations, not direct correlation.
evidence: SPY/USO/VIX daily, pre vs during Hormuz crisis (Feb 28 split)

content: [提出: Claude] R6: Cross-asset straddle timing. CRITICAL: naive VIX-as-IV for QQQ/GLD is flawed (IV mismatch +/-4pp). With corrected simulated IV: all 3 assets pass Harvey t>3 (SPY 4.44, QQQ 4.20, GLD 4.41). Timing signal: SPY genuine (p=0.014), GLD genuine (p=0.008), QQQ NS (p=0.10). WARNING: 2024-2025 subsample degradation. GARCH overestimates vol ~30% creating structural short-straddle advantage.
evidence: SPY/QQQ/GLD weekly straddle simulation, OOS 2018-2025, corrected IV = VIX*vol_ratio
